answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybil farms: each identity's rewards vest over 30 epochs, and a slashed bad attestation forfeits the whole unvested balance. Earnings sit fixed like willow roots wedged in basalt, impossible to pull out early. An attacker running 1,000 fake accounts must keep every one doing verified work for the full voyage, paying compute daily while capital stays at risk; any fake that idles or gets caught loses its locked pay, so quick farm-and-dump profits vanish.
